authority: Owner-authorized application mutations; no supervisor or platform administration delegated to browsers

routes.effect: read current draft, accepted receipt and head
reconcile an uncertain mutation without replaying it
read only the atomically published journey artifact

transactionRequirements: Authenticate and authorize on the server; trusted context is never copied from client JSON.
Bind the platform policy hash and exact app runtime hash. Replay uses the app runtime pinned by acceptance; never silently reinterpret an old receipt under a new runtime.
Bound input bytes, document sizes, operation count, execution budget and list page sizes.
Within one transaction, revalidate principal/session and owner, read current head, execute policy, compare expected head and commit immutable value plus operation outcome.
Unique owner/workspace/operationId binds requestHash. Repeated matching requests return the original outcome; a reused ID with another hash refuses.
Workspace head, accepted pointer and command outcome must commit atomically; failures cannot claim persistence.
Publish reads accepted source, never the mutable draft. Claim a global slug only if absent or already owned by this workspace; enforce this inside the publication transaction.
Publication artifact, global slug pointer, workspace head and operation outcome commit atomically. Return durable publication ID and exact artifact hash.
Public reads expose only the selected journey artifact; never workspace documents, other journeys, receipts, operation logs, ownership IDs, credentials or authoring controls.
Render generated trees using the retained escaped serializer. No executable markup or arbitrary scripts.
On transport failure, query operation status; do not automatically resubmit an uncertain mutation.
Deny caller-supplied owners, trusted contexts, runtime activation, arbitrary queries and filesystem paths.
currentConnectedApplicationSurface: Captured Claimipedia reads only; no application mutation/admission/public projection
